import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

# Measure sigmoid gradient at symmetric points
x_val = 5.0
grad_sigmoid = jax.grad(jax.nn.sigmoid)

# Evaluate at +x and -x
grad_pos = grad_sigmoid(jnp.array(x_val))
grad_neg = grad_sigmoid(jnp.array(-x_val))

# For an even function, gradients at +x and -x should be equal
diff = jnp.abs(grad_pos - grad_neg)

probe('sigmoid_grad_pos', float(grad_pos))
probe('sigmoid_grad_neg', float(grad_neg))
probe('sigmoid_grad_diff', float(diff))

buggy.expm1_gradient:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

# Compare expm1 and exp gradients
grad_expm1 = jax.grad(jnp.expm1)
grad_exp = jax.grad(jnp.exp)

# Test at a value where expm1 might lose accuracy
x_val = 1e-5
grad_expm1_val = grad_expm1(jnp.array(x_val))
grad_exp_val = grad_exp(jnp.array(x_val))

# Both should be approximately equal to exp(x)
diff = jnp.abs(grad_expm1_val - grad_exp_val)
rel_error = diff / grad_exp_val

probe('expm1_grad', float(grad_expm1_val))
probe('exp_grad', float(grad_exp_val))
probe('grad_diff', float(diff))
probe('grad_rel_error', float(rel_error))
